item.title: Soulcraft Brewing files for Subchapter V bankruptcy, expects no disruptions
item.description: Soulcraft Brewing in Salida filed for bankruptcy Oct. 1 under Subchapter V, which provides distressed small businesses a lower-cost and faster process to reorganize their financial debts than traditional Chapter 11 filing.
item.dc:creator: Laurel Swanz, Mail Reporter

item.title: Monarch Hill Climb Auto Race to commence Oct 10-11, fast and technical
item.description: The annual Monarch Hill Climb Auto Race, a technical, high-powered drive up Monarch Pass, will take place Oct. 10-11, starting at the base of Forest Service Road 228 in Garfield, downhill from Monarch Lodge.
item.dc:creator: by Lijah Sampson, Mail Reporter

item.title: WFHS presents Plum Street Heritage Fall Fest Oct. 11
item.description: Western Fremont Historical Society will present its fourth annual Plum Street Heritage Fall Festival from noon to 3 p.m. Oct. 11 at the Cotopaxi-Mullins History Center, CR 12 and Plum Street in Cotopaxi.

item.title: Sventastik to present ‘Annie Get Your Gun’ in early October
item.description: Sventastik Productions will bring the classic musical “Annie Get Your Gun” to the Salida SteamPlant stage in the first two weeks of October.
item.dc:creator: by Lijah Sampson, Mail Reporter

item.title: Guidestone Pumpkin Patch festival sees all ages, a couple of additions
item.description: Guidestone Colorado’s annual Pumpkin Patch and Harvest Festival at the Hutchinson Homestead and Learning Center saw multigenerational crowds coming through in the first weekend, Oct. 2-4, to experience new additions in the event’s 20th year.
item.dc:creator: Lijah Sampson, Mail Reporter

item.title: Salida ArtWalk to bring in more artists and creatives
item.description: Salida ArtWalk rolls into Salida for its 33rd year Oct. 9-11 with more artists and plenty of activities for artists and art lovers of all kinds and ages.

item.title: SHS cross-country girls’ and boys’ teams place second, third at home meet
item.description: The Salida High School cross-country team hosted the Salida High Mountain Desert Twilight meet Oct. 3 at the Salida Golf Club, a brand-new event for the 2026 cross-country season.

item.title: Salida football falls to Limon, 54-20
item.description: The Salida High School football team fell to 2-4 on the season with a 54-20 loss Oct. 2 at Limon.
item.dc:creator: Jack Sellner, Sports Desk

item.title: Salida City Council reviews draft budget, backs ballot measures
item.description: The Salida City Council reviewed the preliminary budget for 2027 and approved resolutions supporting measures appearing on the Nov. 3 general election ballot during a work session and regular meeting Oct. 6.
item.dc:creator: Laurel Swanz, Mail Reporter
